# QgsRasterCalculator

## Syntax
QgsRasterCalculator(formulaString: str | None, outputFile: str | None, outputFormat: str | None, outputExtent: QgsRectangle, outputCrs: QgsCoordinateReferenceSystem, nOutputColumns: int, nOutputRows: int, rasterEntries: Iterable[QgsRasterCalculatorEntry], transformContext: QgsCoordinateTransformContext)

## Description
QgsRasterCalculator constructor. formulaString (Optional[str]) – formula for raster calculation outputFile (Optional[str]) – output file path outputFormat (Optional[str]) – output file format outputExtent (QgsRectangle) – output extent, CRS is specified by outputCrs parameter outputCrs (QgsCoordinateReferenceSystem) – destination CRS for output raster

```python
from qgis.analysis import QgsRasterCalculator
obj = QgsRasterCalculator(formulaString, outputFile, outputFormat, outputExtent, outputCrs, nOutputColumns, nOutputRows, rasterEntries, transformContext)
```

# QgsZonalStatistics

## Syntax
QgsZonalStatistics(polygonLayer: QgsVectorLayer | None, rasterLayer: QgsRasterLayer | None, attributePrefix: str | None = '', rasterBand: int = 1, stats: Qgis.ZonalStatistic = Qgis.ZonalStatistic.Default)

## Description
Convenience constructor for QgsZonalStatistics, using an input raster layer. The raster layer must exist for the lifetime of the zonal statistics calculation. Constructing QgsZonalStatistics using this method is not thread safe, and the constructor which accepts a QgsRasterInterface should be used instead.

```python
from qgis.analysis import QgsZonalStatistics
obj = QgsZonalStatistics(polygonLayer, rasterLayer, attributePrefix, rasterBand, stats)
```

# QgsRasterDataProvider.sample

## Syntax
virtual sample(self, point: QgsPointXY, band: int, boundingBox: QgsRectangle = QgsRectangle(), width: int = 0, height: int = 0, dpi: int = 96)

## Description
Samples a raster value from the specified band found at the point position. The context parameters boundingBox, width and height are important to identify on the same zoom level as a displayed map and to do effective caching (WCS). If context params are not specified the highest resolution is used. If ok is specified and the point is outside data source extent, or an invalid band number was specified, then ok will be set to False. In this case the function will return a NaN v

```python
from qgis.core import QgsRasterDataProvider
result = QgsRasterDataProvider.sample(point, band, boundingBox, width, height, dpi)
```

# QgsRasterInterface.block

## Syntax
abstract block(self, bandNo: int, extent: QgsRectangle, width: int, height: int, feedback: QgsRasterBlockFeedback | None = None) -> QgsRasterBlock | None

## Description
Read block of data using given extent and size. Returns pointer to data. Caller is responsible to free the memory returned. bandNo (int) – band number extent (QgsRectangle) – extent of block width (int) – pixel width of block height (int) – pixel height of block feedback (Optional[QgsRasterBlockFeedback] = None) – optional raster feedback object for cancellation/preview. Added in QGIS 3.0.

```python
from qgis.core import QgsRasterInterface
result = QgsRasterInterface.block(bandNo, extent, width, height, feedback)
```

# QgsRasterFileWriter.writeRaster

## Syntax
writeRaster(self, pipe: QgsRasterPipe | None, nCols: int, nRows: int, outputExtent: QgsRectangle, crs: QgsCoordinateReferenceSystem, feedback: QgsRasterBlockFeedback | None = None) -> Qgis.RasterFileWriterResult

## Description
pipe (Optional[QgsRasterPipe]) – raster pipe nCols (int) – number of output columns outputExtent (QgsRectangle) – extent to output crs (QgsCoordinateReferenceSystem) – crs to reproject to feedback (Optional[QgsRasterBlockFeedback] = None) – optional feedback object for progress reports Deprecated since version 3.8: Use version with transformContext instead.

```python
from qgis.core import QgsRasterFileWriter
result = QgsRasterFileWriter.writeRaster(pipe, nCols, nRows, outputExtent, crs, feedback)
```
